features.description: Compare Free and Premium, then search every listed FiveM feature. Free includes ESP, chams, radar, Lock-on and Triggerbot; Premium adds advanced combat, player controls, Lua and resource tools.

website.notice: Updated 13 October 2026. Free features are also included in Premium. A valid free key or authenticated account is required; Premium features require paid access. Availability depends on the supported FiveM build and session.
website.comparisonHtml:
Free vs Premium

Premium includes everything in Free, plus the paid features below. Use a valid free key for Free access or a paid account for Premium.

FiveM edition comparison
Feature groupFreePremium
Players, NPCs and Self ESP; chams; radarIncludedIncluded
Lock-on, Triggerbot and custom crosshairIncludedIncluded
Profiles, hotkeys and interface settingsIncludedIncluded
Silent Aim and Magic BulletNot includedIncluded
Player and weapon controls; Camera FOVNot includedIncluded
Lua editor, execution and consoleNot includedIncluded
Resource browser, dumper and event toolsNot includedIncluded

Feature availability depends on the supported FiveM build and session. Resource tools work with accessible client files; they do not unlock server-only files or decrypt escrow.

items.label: Independent Players, NPCs and Self ESP
items.desc: Configure each target separately. Players and Unknown NPCs can use their own category settings or inherit Global; Self stays separate.

items.label: Boxes
items.desc: Full and corner boxes with independent width, height and head offset.
settings: Corner length, pulse and screen offsets

items.label: Health bars and HP text
items.desc: Choose position, colors, gradients, smoothing, outlines and text size.

items.label: Armor bars
items.desc: Position and style armor bars separately from health.

items.label: Player and Self names
items.desc: Place labels around the entity with colors, backgrounds, shadows and offsets. NPC name controls are omitted.

items.label: Distance labels
items.desc: Adjust label position, size, colors, backgrounds and offsets.

items.label: Skeletons
items.desc: Bone lines with thickness, gradients, dashed lines, joints, head circles and outlines.

items.label: Weapon names and icons
items.desc: Display the equipped weapon with adjustable icon size and position. Missing images fall back to a weapon label.

items.label: Cone hats
items.desc: Head-anchored overlay hats with radius, height, offset, opacity, gradients, outline, rainbow and spin controls.

items.label: Rings
items.desc: Ground rings with radius, height, count, segments, fill and pulse settings.

items.label: Trails
items.desc: Movement trails with duration, sampling interval, point limit, gradients, taper and outlines.

items.label: Offscreen indicators
items.desc: Remote player and NPC indicators with style, size, screen margin, distance and pulse settings. Not used for Self.

items.label: Snaplines and head dots
items.desc: Choose line origin, thickness and dash style; customize head markers.

items.label: Distance and entity limits
items.desc: Limit rendered players and NPCs and set a maximum display distance.

items.label: Players, NPCs and Self chams
items.desc: Configure separate target profiles with visible and occluded colors, styles, gradients, outlines, glow and fill opacity.
settings: Visible, Occluded and Split preview modes

items.label: Radar
items.desc: Show nearby entities in the radar overlay through Visuals > World.

items.label: Custom crosshair
items.desc: Cross, dot, circle and T-style shapes with size, gap, thickness, color and outline controls.

items.label: Camera FOV
items.desc: Adjust the main camera field of view. Separate ADS and scope camera FOV controls are not implemented.

items.label: Lock-on aimbot
items.desc: Camera aiming with a configurable aim key, FOV radius, distance, target priority, smoothing and movement prediction.

items.label: Lock-on hitbox selection
items.desc: Select Head, Neck, Abdomen, Hands, Feet or Nearest, including multiple hitbox groups.

items.label: Aim behavior and visuals
items.desc: Sticky targeting, switch delay, dead zone, speed limits, offsets and pauses, plus FOV circle, target line and hitbox marker.

items.label: Triggerbot
items.desc: Target-based attack input with hold-key and ADS gates, target filters, hitboxes, distance limits, reaction delay, burst and weapon-aware timing.

items.label: Silent Aim
items.desc: Redirects an actual local weapon shot. Includes target bone, FOV, distance, priority, sticky target, prediction and ADS settings. Requires the matching shot and aiming bindings.

items.label: Magic Bullet
items.desc: Actual-shot redirection with manual firing or Auto Fire. Shares Silent Aim target bone, priority, prediction, FOV, distance, ADS and damage settings, with target marker and line visuals. Requires compatible shot and attack-input bindings.

items.label: God mode
items.desc: Local survivability control, dependent on the current player binding.

items.label: Infinite stamina
items.desc: Maintains local stamina when player data is available.

items.label: Never wanted
items.desc: Controls the local wanted state; this does not override server rules.

items.label: Run and swim speed
items.desc: Separate run and swim multipliers from 1.00 to 1.49.

items.label: Infinite ammo
items.desc: Uses the local inventory binding.

items.label: Recoil, spread, reload and fire rate
items.desc: No recoil, no spread, no reload and rapid fire controls depend on the selected weapon data.

items.label: Lua editor, scripts and console
items.desc: Edit scripts, browse saved scripts and inspect console output.

items.label: Resource execution
items.desc: Choose a resource target and run or stop script execution when the required resource integration is available.

items.label: Local Lua sandbox
items.desc: Run local sandbox scripts. Sandbox execution also requires premium and does not validate gameplay.

items.label: Event capture and replay
items.desc: Inspect captured inbound/outbound events and replay supported payloads. Availability depends on matching bindings and the session; server responses are not guaranteed.

items.label: Resource and file browser
items.desc: Browse running resources, filter the resource list, explore file trees and preview accessible source files.

items.label: Resource dumper
items.desc: Dump selected resources or all accessible resources, follow export progress, cancel a running export and open the output folder. Exports accessible client files, not arbitrary server-only files or escrow decryption.

items.label: V1 and V2 interfaces
items.desc: Choose an interface style and retain the saved selection. New installations default to V2.

items.label: Saved profiles and hotkeys
items.desc: Save supported settings and feature bindings. Loading a profile does not unlock premium features.

items.label: Logging
items.desc: Inspect application messages and missing game-data dependencies.
